readout_other: STN local field potentials (Medtronic Percept); EEG; random dot-motion reaction time; stop-signal task; abbreviated UPDRS-III
direction_notes: GPi-TUS versus ventricle-TUS reduced ipsilateral STN beta power by 10.34% and median reaction time by 17.70%; abbreviated UPDRS-III not significantly changed.
safety_notes: Thermal simulations gave a mean maximum temperature rise of 0.47 ± 0.37 °C; no clinical adverse-event report given.

device.model: H294 single element planar transducer, 64 mm diameter, with personalised PDMS acoustic lens

timing.protocol_description: 800 ms pulse trains repeated every 2.5 s; within each train 90 µs pulses at 130 Hz PRF (duty cycle 1.17%); five 5-minute active blocks per day, after a sham block, with an auditory masking signal.

source_quotes.n_subjects: in four male participants with PD
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: This was applied to either the left GPi or left ventricle on consecutive days in a randomised order
